QUOTE: `library/common.h:132` | Internal header. Any library `.c` that includes it before `private_access.h` gets raw field names. This is the main "for whom": the library itself.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the internal shared header common.h turns the opt-out on, so library files that include it see raw member names. It hedges on include order, but the mechanism and location are stated.
